discovery: All638 V5 confirmed target writing parents. Existing311 V3 assignments frozen; source-confirmed327 UNK diagnosed before candidate classes. Nonwriting/unresolved membership excluded; competing contacts separated from resolved-parent discovery.

fresh_validation.field: First ordinary horizontal source field from existing V4 geometry, source RGB only. All primary parents in safe field reviewed, no predicted-class selection. A bad field is retained as insufficient evidence, not replaced for recurrence.
fresh_validation.exposure: Captions unused to define V6; existing V4 image/geometry exposure and V3 source-model exposure disclosed. Not globally unseen photographs.

diagnosis.warning: Raster instability is not evidence of a new class. Visual source tags are hypotheses with unknown retained.

candidates.basis: Whole connected RGB-reviewed resolved writing parents only. Frozen V3 embedding and topology; complete-link distance grouping fixed before heldout assignments. No sequence inputs.
candidates.radius: 90th percentile leave-caption-out nearest exemplar distance; radius capped0.35
candidates.source_review: Native RGB examples must exhibit the same whole-parent organization; variants/composites remain separate descriptions, not V3 merges.

composition.search: Four outside-band removals at0.20/0.30/0.40 parent extent; base requires frozen V3 fit and threshold/slant agreement; residual15..45 percent ink and connected to retained base at primary threshold. Measurement factor only; no pen lift, grapheme or order asserted.
composition.validation: Composition candidates must recur on>=3 train captions,>=3 fresh captions and>=5 fresh parents; same native pair standards as whole-parent candidates; unvalidated factors never substitute class tokens.
composition.competing: Record all successful base/window explanations, never choose by sequence completeness

pair_audit: Anonymous randomized RGB-only pairs, class/kind hidden. Positive n10 per eligible class from distinct fresh/training pairings where available; negative n20 per class using closest topology-matched nonmember. Unknown judgments counted as failure/abstention. Same AI adjudicator, not independent human-rater validation.
abstention: Any unresolved parent contact, insufficient image, inconsistent topology/contact under6/9/12, class-margin failure, rejected visual organization, or failed class gate remains UNK. V3 assignments never changed.
stages: diagnose all V5 confirmed UNK/source atlas
fresh source confirmation seal before test assignments
heldout inference and masked native pair validation
only then reuse unchanged V5 sequence partitions
forbidden: sequence recurrence for training or class selection
